target.purpose: Detect safety-policy regressions by replaying golden refusal cases with expected decisions and reasons and failing closed when behavior drifts.
target.central_bottleneck: A refuse-to-allow regression can look like ordinary model variation unless expected refusal semantics are replayed deterministically.
success: Golden cases preserve expected refusal decisions and reasons.
Replay fails when a protected refusal changes to allow or loses its required reason semantics.
Regression output is deterministic enough to bind to repository proof.

invariants: protected golden refusals cannot silently become allows
expected refusal reason semantics remain explicit
replay drift is surfaced as failure, not normalized away

donor_plan.basis: The current repository owns the implemented refusal-replay mechanism; no donor implementation is required to define or operate it.
donor_plan.future_extraction: Reusable replay semantics may be extracted only with lineage, functional/proof equivalence, and preservation of this repository's identity.

nonclaims: reference safety-regression engineering system, not a production model policy service
